purpose: Controlled full-task comparison with source-derived labels and a separate small human semantic review layer.
status: Contract validation implemented; generator, derivation replay, v2 runner and blind test set are not yet complete.

controlled_layer.source_manifest: Each named file path and SHA-256 must resolve within the frozen source root; effective_inputs_sha256 binds file paths, hashes and coordinate/event metadata.
controlled_layer.case_derivation: Each case declares generator/template/parameter hashes, source evidence types, and no unresolved ambiguity; a separate derivation replay must reproduce the label before formal scoring.
controlled_layer.unknown_policy: Missing or contradictory source evidence rejects the case; it cannot become a feasible route by default.
controlled_layer.tool_use: Tool-sequence gold is optional and reported separately. It must not determine complete-task success for source-derived cases.

semantic_review_layer.status: Development packet prepared; human conclusions pending.
semantic_review_layer.denominator: Separate from the 300 controlled scenarios and their repeats.

formal_gate: All input bytes and source manifest verified
Every generated label reproduced independently before model outputs are seen
Exactly 300 unseen controlled scenarios, 50 per category and three repeats
Agent readiness snapshot, matching commit and clean tracked worktree
Same-model baseline configuration and batch cost approved before API calls
